caseNameFull: Estelle, Director, Texas Department of Corrections v. Wiggins

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 459 U. S. 1199.] Motion of respondent for appointment of counsel granted, and it is ordered that Craig Smyser, Esquire, of Houston, Tex., be appointed to serve as counsel for respondent in this case. In all other respects the motion is denied.
